diagnostic_scenarios.meaning: Tests verify reproduction of rejection/inconsistent behavior, not that this behavior is safe or fixed.

confirmed_runtime_evidence: First four STRAIGHT commands end without prequeue with capture_not_fresh and 10/10 usable frames.
Corner WAIT is line_corner_waiting_for_fresh_distance; next decision wait_sec=11.434.
System realtime-minus-monotonic offset jumps forward about 371.409 seconds after camera startup.
inference_limit: No recorded capture ages or ball vision_transport messages from the failing interval. NTP-induced camera/ROS timestamp mismatch is strongly supported but exact per-frame age and ball rejection cause cannot be recovered from these logs.
